description: Empty state that explains the situation and offers a next action when it applies.

howToUse: Use it where a list or area has nothing to show: first visit, a search with no results, a finished queue.
Say why it is empty in the `title` and what to do in the `message`: "No invoices yet" / "Invoices show up here after the first sale".
Offer the next step in `action`: create the first item, or clear the filters.

keyboard.action: Moves to the action, when there is one. The message does not receive focus.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon inside the frame (via prop, never bundled).

props.name: bordered
props.description: Dashed border around it, signaling absence. Default `true`.
